uz: SAVOL: Turning gear nima uchun soatlab ishlaydi? JAVOB: Issiq rotorni bir tekis sovutib, egilib qolishi (bow)ning oldini olish uchun.
en: Q: Why does the turning gear run for hours? A: To cool the hot rotor evenly and prevent it from bowing.

uz: 'Wobbe index' — yoqilg'i gazining yonish 'kuchini' o'lchaydigan ko'rsatkich. Gaz tarkibi o'zgarsa, turbina sozlamalari ham moslashtirilishi kerak.
en: The 'Wobbe index' measures the combustion 'strength' of fuel gas. If gas composition changes, turbine settings must adapt.

uz: Tabiiy gaz tarkibi manbaga qarab farq qiladi — turbina turli 'Wobbe index'li gazda barqaror ishlashi uchun boshqaruv tizimi moslashadi.
en: Natural gas composition varies by source — the control system adapts so the turbine runs stably on gas of different Wobbe index.

uz: 'Purge' (tozalash) — ishga tushirishdan oldin yonish yo'lidan yonuvchi gazni havo bilan surib chiqarish. Bu yoqishda portlash xavfini yo'qotadi.
en: A 'purge' clears combustible gas from the combustion path with air before startup. This removes explosion risk at ignition.

uz: Ishga tushirish tartibi 'purge → ignition → warm-up → acceleration → synchronization' ketma-ketligida boradi — har qadam tekshiriladi.
en: The startup sequence goes 'purge → ignition → warm-up → acceleration → synchronization' — each step is verified.

uz: SAVOL: Nega yoqishdan oldin 'purge' qilinadi? JAVOB: Yonish yo'lidagi to'plangan gazni chiqarib, portlash xavfini yo'qotish uchun.
en: Q: Why is a purge done before ignition? A: To clear accumulated gas from the combustion path and remove explosion risk.

uz: 'Cooldown' (sovutish) — to'xtatishdan keyin turbinani rejalashtirilgan tartibda sovutish. Tez sovutish ham, tez qizdirish kabi, zararli.
en: 'Cooldown' is cooling a turbine in a planned manner after shutdown. Fast cooling, like fast heating, is harmful.

uz: Katta turbina to'liq sovishi bir necha kun davom etishi mumkin — shuning uchun 'hot restart' (issiq qayta ishga tushirish) tez amalga oshiriladi.
en: A large turbine can take days to fully cool — which is why a 'hot restart' can be done quickly.

uz: 'Efficiency degradation' — vaqt o'tishi bilan FIKning asta pasayishi (ifloslanish, yeyilish). Yuvish va ta'mir uni qisman tiklaydi.
en: 'Efficiency degradation' is the gradual drop in efficiency over time (fouling, wear). Washing and repair partly restore it.

uz: FIKning 'recoverable' (tiklanadigan) qismi yuvish bilan qaytadi, 'non-recoverable' qismi esa faqat qismlarni almashtirish bilan tiklanadi.
en: The 'recoverable' part of efficiency returns with washing, while the 'non-recoverable' part is restored only by replacing parts.

uz: SAVOL: Kompressor yuvish qanday FIK yo'qotishini tiklaydi? JAVOB: Ifloslanishdan kelib chiqqan 'tiklanadigan' (recoverable) qismini — pichoqlar tozalanadi.
en: Q: What kind of efficiency loss does compressor washing restore? A: The 'recoverable' part caused by fouling — the blades are cleaned.

uz: 'Heat rate' — bir birlik elektr ishlab chiqarish uchun sarflangan issiqlik. U qancha past bo'lsa, stansiya shuncha samarali.
en: 'Heat rate' is the heat used to produce one unit of electricity. The lower it is, the more efficient the plant.

uz: Heat rate va FIK bir narsaning ikki ko'rinishi — past heat rate yuqori FIKni bildiradi. Ular stansiya samaradorligini o'lchaydi.
en: Heat rate and efficiency are two views of the same thing — a low heat rate means high efficiency. Both measure plant performance.

uz: 'Availability' — stansiyaning ishlashga tayyor bo'lgan vaqti ulushi. Yuqori availability ko'proq daromad va ishonchlilikni bildiradi.
en: 'Availability' is the fraction of time a plant is ready to run. High availability means more revenue and reliability.

uz: SAVOL: Past 'heat rate' nimani bildiradi? JAVOB: Yuqori samaradorlikni — kam yoqilg'i bilan ko'proq elektr ishlab chiqariladi.
en: Q: What does a low heat rate indicate? A: High efficiency — more electricity produced with less fuel.

uz: 'Emissions' (chiqindilar) — NOx, CO va CO₂. Zamonaviy stansiyalar ularni past ushlash uchun DLN combustor va monitoring tizimlaridan foydalanadi.
en: 'Emissions' include NOx, CO and CO₂. Modern plants use DLN combustors and monitoring systems to keep them low.

uz: 'CEMS' (Continuous Emissions Monitoring System) chiqindilarni real vaqtda o'lchaydi — bu ekologik me'yorlarga rioya qilinishini ta'minlaydi.
en: A CEMS (Continuous Emissions Monitoring System) measures emissions in real time — ensuring compliance with environmental limits.

uz: NOx (azot oksidi) yuqori haroratda havodagi azotdan hosil bo'ladi. Yonishni tekis va nazorat ostida ushlash uni kamaytiradi.
en: NOx (nitrogen oxides) form from air's nitrogen at high temperatures. Keeping combustion even and controlled reduces it.

uz: SAVOL: CEMS nima o'lchaydi? JAVOB: Stansiya chiqindilarini (NOx, CO va h.k.) real vaqtda — ekologik me'yorlarga rioya uchun.
en: Q: What does a CEMS measure? A: Plant emissions (NOx, CO, etc.) in real time — for environmental compliance.

uz: 'Bypass stack' — HRSG'ni chetlab o'tib, gaz turbinasi gazini to'g'ridan-to'g'ri chiqaradigan mo'ri. U ba'zi stansiyalarda turbinani mustaqil ishlatish imkonini beradi.
en: A 'bypass stack' lets gas turbine exhaust go straight out, bypassing the HRSG. In some plants it allows running the turbine independently.

uz: 'Damper' (to'siq) chiqindi gaz oqimini HRSG yoki bypass tomon yo'naltiradi — bu stansiya rejimini o'zgartirish imkonini beradi.
en: A 'damper' directs exhaust flow toward the HRSG or the bypass — allowing the plant's mode to be changed.

uz: 'Duct burner' — HRSG ichida qo'shimcha yoqilg'i yoqib, ko'proq bug' hosil qiladigan gorelka. U talab yuqori bo'lganda quvvatni oshiradi.
en: A 'duct burner' is a burner inside the HRSG that burns extra fuel to make more steam. It boosts power when demand is high.

uz: SAVOL: 'Duct burner' nima uchun ishlatiladi? JAVOB: HRSG'da qo'shimcha issiqlik berib, ko'proq bug' va qo'shimcha quvvat hosil qilish uchun.
en: Q: Why is a duct burner used? A: To add heat in the HRSG, producing more steam and extra power.

uz: 'Steam bypass' tizimi turbina qabul qila olmaган bug'ni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri kondensatorga yo'naltiradi — bu ishga tushirish va yuk o'zgarishlarida foydali.
en: A 'steam bypass' system routes steam the turbine can't accept straight to the condenser — useful during startup and load changes.

uz: Steam bypass turbinani himoya qiladi: agar u to'satdan yukdan tushsa, ortiqcha bug' xavfsiz kondensatorga boradi, bosim oshib ketmaydi.
en: A steam bypass protects the turbine: if it suddenly sheds load, excess steam goes safely to the condenser and pressure doesn't spike.

uz: 'Attemperator' (desuperheater) bug'ga oz suv purkab, uning haroratini kerakli darajaga tushiradi — juda issiq bug' turbinani shikastlashi mumkin.
en: An 'attemperator' (desuperheater) sprays a little water into steam to lower its temperature to the required level — steam that's too hot can damage the turbine.

uz: SAVOL: 'Steam bypass' turbinani qanday himoya qiladi? JAVOB: Turbina qabul qilolmagan ortiqcha bug'ni kondensatorga yo'naltirib, bosim oshib ketishining oldini oladi.
en: Q: How does a steam bypass protect the turbine? A: By routing excess steam the turbine can't take to the condenser, preventing pressure spikes.

uz: 'Rotor air cooler' — generator rotorini sovutuvchi havoni sovutadigan issiqlik almashtirgich (vodorodli mashinalarda vodorodni sovutadi).
en: A 'rotor air cooler' is a heat exchanger that cools the air (or hydrogen in H₂ machines) cooling the generator rotor.

uz: Generator ichidagi sovutuvchi muhit (havo/vodorod) yopiq aylanadi: qiziydi, cooler'da soviydi, qaytadan generatorga kiradi.
en: The coolant inside a generator (air/hydrogen) circulates in a closed loop: it heats up, cools in the cooler, and re-enters the generator.

uz: 'Partial discharge' — generator izolatsiyasidagi mayda elektr uchqunlar. Ularni kuzatish izolatsiya eskirishini oldindan sezishga yordam beradi.
en: 'Partial discharge' refers to tiny electrical sparks within generator insulation. Monitoring them helps detect insulation aging early.

uz: SAVOL: 'Partial discharge' monitoringi nimaga yordam beradi? JAVOB: Generator izolatsiyasining eskirishini erta aniqlab, kutilmagan nosozlikning oldini olishga.
en: Q: What does partial discharge monitoring help with? A: Detecting generator insulation aging early, preventing unexpected failure.

uz: 'LOTO' (Lockout-Tagout) — ta'mir paytida jihozni tasodifan yoqilishdan saqlaydigan xavfsizlik tartibi. Energiya manbai qulflanadi va belgi osiladi.
en: LOTO (Lockout-Tagout) is a safety procedure that prevents equipment from being switched on accidentally during repair. The energy source is locked and a tag is hung.

uz: LOTO'da faqat ishni bajaruvchi shaxs qulfni ochishi mumkin — bu boshqa birov bexosdan jihozni yoqib yuborishning oldini oladi.
en: In LOTO only the person doing the work can remove the lock — preventing someone else from accidentally energizing the equipment.

uz: SAVOL: LOTO nima uchun kerak? JAVOB: Ta'mir paytida jihoz tasodifan yoqilib, ishchini shikastlashining oldini olish uchun.
en: Q: Why is LOTO needed? A: To prevent equipment being accidentally energized during repair and injuring the worker.

uz: 'Confined space' (yopiq/tor makon) — HRSG yoki kondensator ichi kabi joylar. Ularga kirishdan oldin havo tarkibi tekshiriladi, chunki kislorod kam yoki zaharli gaz bo'lishi mumkin.
en: A 'confined space' is a place like the inside of an HRSG or condenser. Before entry the air is tested, since oxygen may be low or toxic gas present.

uz: Tor makonga kirishda doim tashqarida kuzatuvchi (attendant) turadi — favqulodda holatda darhol yordam chaqirish uchun.
en: When entering a confined space, an attendant always stays outside — to summon help immediately in an emergency.

uz: SAVOL: Nega tor makonga (confined space) kirishdan oldin havo tekshiriladi? JAVOB: Kislorod yetarli va zaharli/yonuvchi gaz yo'qligiga ishonch hosil qilish uchun.
en: Q: Why is air tested before entering a confined space? A: To confirm oxygen is sufficient and no toxic/flammable gas is present.

uz: 'Hot work' — payvandlash yoki kesish kabi uchqun/olov chiqaradigan ishlar. Ular uchun maxsus ruxsat (permit) olinadi va yong'in choralari ko'riladi.
en: 'Hot work' is work like welding or cutting that produces sparks/flame. It requires a special permit and fire precautions.

uz: Yoqilg'i gaz yoki moy bo'lgan hududda 'hot work' juda xavfli — avval hudud gazdan tozalanadi va tekshiriladi.
en: Hot work near fuel gas or oil is very dangerous — the area is first cleared of gas and tested.

uz: 'Permit to work' tizimi — xavfli ishni boshlashdan oldin yozma ruxsat olish. U kim, qachon, qanday xavfsizlik choralari bilan ishlashini belgilaydi.
en: A 'permit to work' system requires written authorization before starting hazardous work. It defines who, when, and with what safety measures.

uz: SAVOL: 'Hot work permit' nima uchun kerak? JAVOB: Uchqun/olovli ishlarni faqat xavfsiz, tekshirilgan sharoitda bajarishni ta'minlash uchun.
en: Q: Why is a hot work permit needed? A: To ensure spark/flame work is done only under safe, verified conditions.

uz: Turbina pichoqlari 'superqotishmalar' (superalloys) — nikel asosidagi metallardan tayyorlanadi. Ular juda yuqori haroratda ham mustahkamligini saqlaydi.
en: Turbine blades are made of 'superalloys' — nickel-based metals. They keep their strength even at very high temperatures.

uz: Oddiy po'lat ~600°C da yumshab qoladi, superqotishmalar esa 900°C dan yuqorida ham ishlay oladi — shu sabab turbinada ishlatiladi.
en: Ordinary steel softens around 600°C, while superalloys work above 900°C — which is why they're used in turbines.

uz: 'Creep' — metallning yuqori harorat va yukdan asta cho'zilishi. Turbina pichoqlari yillar davomida sekin cho'ziladi, shuning uchun umri cheklangan.
en: 'Creep' is the slow stretching of metal under high temperature and load. Turbine blades slowly elongate over years, so their life is limited.

uz: SAVOL: Nega turbina pichoqlari superqotishmadan yasaladi? JAVOB: Ular juda yuqori haroratda ham mustahkam qolib, erish va cho'zilishga (creep) chidaydi.
en: Q: Why are turbine blades made of superalloys? A: They stay strong at very high temperatures, resisting melting and creep.

uz: 'Coating' (qoplama) turbina pichoqlarini issiqlik, oksidlanish va korroziyadan himoya qiladi. Vaqt o'tishi bilan qoplama yeyiladi va qayta suriladi.
en: A 'coating' protects turbine blades from heat, oxidation and corrosion. Over time the coating wears and is reapplied.

uz: 'Oksidlanish' — metallning kislorod bilan reaksiyasi (zanglashning yuqori haroratli turi). Qoplama metallni undan himoya qiladi.
en: 'Oxidation' is metal reacting with oxygen (a high-temperature form of rusting). Coatings protect the metal from it.

uz: 'Hot corrosion' — yoqilg'i yoki havodagi tuzlar yuqori haroratda metallni yemirishi. Toza yoqilg'i va havo bu xavfni kamaytiradi.
en: 'Hot corrosion' is salts in fuel or air attacking metal at high temperature. Clean fuel and air reduce this risk.

uz: SAVOL: Turbina pichog'idagi qoplama (coating) nima uchun kerak? JAVOB: Pichoqni issiqlik, oksidlanish va korroziyadan himoya qilib, umrini uzaytirish uchun.
en: Q: Why do turbine blades need a coating? A: To protect them from heat, oxidation and corrosion, extending their life.

uz: 'NDT' (Non-Destructive Testing) — jihozni buzmasdan tekshirish usullari: ultratovush, radiografiya, magnit zarrachalar. Ular yashirin yoriqlarni topadi.
en: NDT (Non-Destructive Testing) inspects equipment without damaging it: ultrasound, radiography, magnetic particles. They find hidden cracks.

uz: Ultratovushli tekshiruv metall ichidagi yoriqni tovush to'lqinlari orqali 'ko'radi' — xuddi tibbiy UZI kabi.
en: Ultrasonic testing 'sees' cracks inside metal using sound waves — much like a medical ultrasound.

uz: SAVOL: NDT (non-destructive testing) nima afzallik beradi? JAVOB: Jihozni sindirmasdan yoki kesib ko'rmasdan ichki nuqsonlarni aniqlash imkonini beradi.
en: Q: What advantage does NDT offer? A: It detects internal defects without breaking or cutting the equipment.

uz: 'Governor droop' — bir necha generator bir to'rda ishlaganda yukni adolatli taqsimlaydigan sozlama. Har biri chastota o'zgarishiga mutanosib javob beradi.
en: 'Governor droop' is a setting that fairly shares load among several generators on one grid. Each responds proportionally to frequency change.

uz: Droop tufayli generatorlar bir-biri bilan 'kurashmaydi' — har biri o'z ulushini oladi va to'r barqaror qoladi.
en: Thanks to droop, generators don't 'fight' each other — each takes its share and the grid stays stable.

uz: 'Spinning reserve' — to'rga ulangan, lekin to'liq yuklanmagan zaxira quvvat. Talab to'satdan oshsa, u bir zumda ishga solinadi.
en: 'Spinning reserve' is reserve capacity connected to the grid but not fully loaded. If demand suddenly rises, it kicks in instantly.

uz: SAVOL: 'Spinning reserve' nima uchun kerak? JAVOB: Talab to'satdan oshganda yoki boshqa generator o'chganda tezda quvvat berib, to'rni saqlash uchun.
en: Q: Why is spinning reserve needed? A: To quickly supply power when demand spikes or another generator trips, keeping the grid up.

uz: 'Island mode' — stansiya asosiy to'rdan ajralib, faqat mahalliy yukni ta'minlab ishlashi. Bu qiyin rejim, chunki chastotani o'zi ushlashi kerak.
en: 'Island mode' is when a plant separates from the main grid and supplies only local load. It's a demanding mode, as it must hold frequency alone.

uz: Island rejimida generator o'zining chastotasi va kuchlanishini yakka o'zi boshqaradi — katta to'rning 'yordami' bo'lmaydi.
en: In island mode a generator controls its own frequency and voltage alone — without the 'support' of a large grid.

uz: 'Ramp rate' — turbina quvvatini qanchalik tez oshirish/kamaytirish mumkinligi (MW/daqiqa). Tez ramp foydali, lekin jihozni ko'proq charchatadi.
en: 'Ramp rate' is how fast a turbine's power can be raised/lowered (MW/minute). Fast ramping is useful but wears equipment more.

uz: SAVOL: 'Ramp rate' nimani bildiradi? JAVOB: Turbina quvvatini qanchalik tez o'zgartirish mumkinligini (masalan MW/daqiqa).
en: Q: What does 'ramp rate' mean? A: How fast a turbine's power can be changed (e.g. MW/minute).

uz: 'Combined cycle' ikki xil ishga tushiriladi: '2x1' (ikki gaz turbinasi bitta bug' turbinasiga) yoki '1x1' (bittadan). 2x1 ko'proq moslashuvchan.
en: Combined cycle is configured as '2x1' (two gas turbines feeding one steam turbine) or '1x1' (one each). 2x1 is more flexible.

uz: 2x1 tuzilmada bitta gaz turbinasini to'xtatib, ikkinchisini ishlatib turish mumkin — bu qulaylik va ishonchlilikni oshiradi.
en: In a 2x1 arrangement one gas turbine can be stopped while the other keeps running — improving flexibility and reliability.

uz: SAVOL: '2x1' combined cycle nima degani? JAVOB: Ikki gaz turbinasining chiqindi issig'i bitta bug' turbinasini ta'minlashi.
en: Q: What does a '2x1' combined cycle mean? A: Two gas turbines' exhaust heat feeding one steam turbine.

uz: 'Once-through' HRSG — barabansiz, suv to'g'ridan-to'g'ri bug'ga aylanadi. U tez ishga tushishga imkon beradi va zamonaviy stansiyalarda ko'p uchraydi.
en: A 'once-through' HRSG has no drum — water turns to steam directly. It allows faster startup and is common in modern plants.

uz: Barabanli HRSG sekinroq, lekin oddiyroq; once-through tezroq ishga tushadi, lekin suv sifatiga qattiqroq talab qo'yadi.
en: A drum-type HRSG is slower but simpler; a once-through starts faster but demands stricter water quality.

uz: 'Condensate polisher' — kondensat suvini yana bir bor ultra-toza qiladigan filtr. U bug' siklidagi eng kichik ifloslikni ham ushlaydi.
en: A 'condensate polisher' is a filter that makes condensate water ultra-pure once more. It catches even the tiniest contamination in the steam cycle.

uz: SAVOL: 'Once-through' HRSG barabanli HRSG'dan qanday farq qiladi? JAVOB: Barabani yo'q — suv to'g'ridan bug'ga aylanadi, bu tez ishga tushishga imkon beradi.
en: Q: How does a once-through HRSG differ from a drum type? A: It has no drum — water converts directly to steam, allowing faster startup.

uz: 'Feedwater' — HRSG'ga haydaladigan suv. U avval qizdiriladi va deaeratorda kislorodsizlantiriladi, so'ng yuqori bosim ostida qozonga boradi.
en: 'Feedwater' is water pumped into the HRSG. It's first heated and deaerated, then sent to the boiler under high pressure.

uz: Feedwater harorati qancha yuqori bo'lsa, uni bug'ga aylantirish uchun shuncha kam qo'shimcha issiqlik kerak — bu samaradorlikni oshiradi.
en: The hotter the feedwater, the less extra heat is needed to boil it to steam — improving efficiency.

uz: 'Blowdown' — qozon suvidan bir qismini chiqarib tashlash. Bug'lanish natijasida to'plangan tuzlarni olib chiqib, quyqa hosil bo'lishini oldini oladi.
en: 'Blowdown' removes part of the boiler water. It carries out salts concentrated by evaporation, preventing scale buildup.

uz: SAVOL: Qozon 'blowdown'i nima uchun qilinadi? JAVOB: Bug'lanishdan to'plangan tuzlarni chiqarib, quyqa va korroziyaning oldini olish uchun.
en: Q: Why is boiler blowdown performed? A: To remove salts concentrated by evaporation, preventing scale and corrosion.

uz: 'Steam quality' — bug'da suyuq tomchi qancha kamligini ko'rsatadi. Yuqori sifatli (quruq) bug' turbina pichoqlarini yeyilishdan saqlaydi.
en: 'Steam quality' shows how few liquid droplets are in the steam. High-quality (dry) steam protects turbine blades from erosion.

uz: Bug'dagi suv tomchilari yuqori tezlikda pichoqqa urilib, ularni asta yeydi (erozion) — shuning uchun bug' quruq bo'lishi kerak.
en: Water droplets in steam strike blades at high speed, slowly eroding them — which is why steam must be dry.

uz: 'Last stage blade' (LP oxirgi bosqich pichog'i) bug' turbinasidagi eng uzun va eng ko'p sinovga tushadigan pichoq — u katta hajmdagi past bosimli bug'ni qabul qiladi.
en: The last stage blade (LP final stage) is the longest and most stressed blade in a steam turbine — it handles a large volume of low-pressure steam.

uz: SAVOL: Nega bug' quruq (yuqori sifatli) bo'lishi kerak? JAVOB: Suv tomchilari pichoqlarga urilib ularni yeydi (erozion), quruq bug' esa ularni saqlaydi.
en: Q: Why must steam be dry (high quality)? A: Water droplets strike and erode blades, while dry steam protects them.

uz: 'Cold reheat' va 'hot reheat' — bug'ni turbinaning yuqori bosim qismidan chiqib, HRSG'da qayta qizdirilib, o'rta bosim qismiga qaytishi. Bu FIKni oshiradi.
en: 'Cold reheat' and 'hot reheat' describe steam leaving the HP turbine, being reheated in the HRSG, and returning to the IP turbine. This raises efficiency.

uz: 'Reheat' sikli bug'ni ikki marta qizdirib, undan ko'proq ish oladi va oxirgi bosqichda bug'ni quruqroq saqlaydi.
en: The 'reheat' cycle heats steam twice, extracting more work and keeping the steam drier in the final stages.

uz: SAVOL: Bug'ni 'reheat' qilish (qayta qizdirish) nima beradi? JAVOB: Ko'proq ish oladi, FIKni oshiradi va oxirgi bosqichda bug'ni quruqroq saqlaydi.
en: Q: What does reheating steam achieve? A: It extracts more work, raises efficiency, and keeps steam drier in the last stages.

uz: 'Auxiliary boiler' (yordamchi qozon) — stansiya ishga tushishdan oldin kerakli bug'ni beradi (masalan gland seal uchun). Asosiy tizim ishga tushgach, u o'chiriladi.
en: An 'auxiliary boiler' provides the steam needed before the plant starts (e.g. for gland seals). Once the main system runs, it's shut off.

uz: Stansiya 'muyoq' (chicken-and-egg) muammosini yordamchi qozon hal qiladi: bug' hosil qilish uchun bug' kerak bo'lganda, u boshlang'ich bug'ni beradi.
en: An auxiliary boiler solves a 'chicken-and-egg' problem: when steam is needed to make steam, it provides the initial steam.

uz: SAVOL: Yordamchi qozon (auxiliary boiler) nima uchun kerak? JAVOB: Stansiya ishga tushishidan oldin boshlang'ich bug'ni (masalan gland seal uchun) ta'minlash uchun.
en: Q: Why is an auxiliary boiler needed? A: To provide the initial steam (e.g. for gland seals) before the plant starts up.

uz: 'Pressure transmitter' (bosim datchigi) suyuqlik yoki gaz bosimini o'lchab, uni elektr signalga aylantiradi. Stansiyada yuzlab shunday datchiklar bor.
en: A pressure transmitter measures the pressure of liquid or gas and converts it to an electrical signal. A plant has hundreds of them.

uz: Sanoat datchiklari ko'pincha '4-20 mA' signal beradi — 4 mA eng past, 20 mA eng yuqori qiymat. Bu shovqinga chidamli standart.
en: Industrial sensors often output a '4-20 mA' signal — 4 mA is the lowest, 20 mA the highest value. It's a noise-resistant standard.

uz: 'Flow meter' (oqim o'lchagich) quvurdan o'tayotgan suyuqlik yoki gaz miqdorini o'lchaydi. Turli tiplari bor: differensial bosim, ultratovush, magnit.
en: A flow meter measures the amount of liquid or gas passing through a pipe. Types include differential pressure, ultrasonic and magnetic.

uz: SAVOL: Nega sanoat datchiklari '4-20 mA' signalidan foydalanadi? JAVOB: Bu elektr shovqinga chidamli va uzoq masofaga ishonchli uzatiladigan standart.
en: Q: Why do industrial sensors use a '4-20 mA' signal? A: It's a standard that resists electrical noise and transmits reliably over distance.

uz: 'Level transmitter' (sath datchigi) bak yoki barabandagi suyuqlik sathini o'lchaydi. Bug' barabanida sath nazorati juda muhim — suv kam yoki ko'p bo'lsa xavfli.
en: A level transmitter measures liquid level in a tank or drum. Level control in a steam drum is critical — too little or too much water is dangerous.

uz: Bug' barabanida suv sathi juda pasaysa, qizigan quvurlar suvsiz qolib kuyishi mumkin; juda ko'tarilsa, suv turbinaga o'tib ketishi mumkin.
en: If the water level in a steam drum drops too low, hot tubes can overheat dry; if it rises too high, water can carry over into the turbine.

uz: SAVOL: Bug' barabanida suv sathi nazorati nega muhim? JAVOB: Kam suv quvurlarni kuydiradi, ortiqcha suv esa turbinaga o'tib zarar beradi.
en: Q: Why is water level control in a steam drum important? A: Too little water overheats tubes; too much carries into the turbine and damages it.

uz: 'PID controller' — datchik qiymatini kerakli qiymatga (setpoint) yaqinlashtirib boshqaradigan mantiq. U proporsional, integral va differensial qismlardan iborat.
en: A PID controller adjusts a process toward a desired value (setpoint) using proportional, integral and derivative terms.

uz: PID boshqaruv turbina tezligi, harorat, bosim va sathni tekis ushlaydi — u kichik og'ishni sezib, darhol tuzatadi.
en: PID control keeps turbine speed, temperature, pressure and level steady — sensing small deviations and correcting them instantly.

uz: SAVOL: 'Setpoint' nima? JAVOB: Boshqaruv tizimi ushlashga harakat qiladigan maqsadli qiymat (masalan kerakli harorat yoki bosim).
en: Q: What is a 'setpoint'? A: The target value the control system tries to maintain (e.g. desired temperature or pressure).

uz: 'Actuator' — boshqaruv signalini fizik harakatga aylantiradigan qurilma. U klapanni ochadi/yopadi yoki pichoqni buradi. Elektr, pnevmatik yoki gidravlik bo'ladi.
en: An 'actuator' converts a control signal into physical motion. It opens/closes a valve or turns a vane. It can be electric, pneumatic or hydraulic.

uz: Katta klapanlarni harakatga keltirishga ko'p kuch kerak — shuning uchun ko'pincha gidravlik (moy bosimi) yoki pnevmatik (havo bosimi) aktuatorlar ishlatiladi.
en: Moving large valves needs great force — so hydraulic (oil pressure) or pneumatic (air pressure) actuators are often used.

uz: 'Fail-safe' — nosozlik yuz berganda tizim xavfsiz holatga o'tishi. Masalan, signal yo'qolsa, yoqilg'i klapani o'z-o'zidan yopiladi.
en: 'Fail-safe' means the system moves to a safe state if a failure occurs. For example, if the signal is lost, the fuel valve closes by itself.

uz: SAVOL: 'Fail-safe' klapan signal yo'qolganda nima qiladi? JAVOB: O'z-o'zidan xavfsiz holatga o'tadi — masalan yoqilg'i klapani yopiladi.
en: Q: What does a fail-safe valve do when the signal is lost? A: It moves to a safe state by itself — e.g. the fuel valve closes.

uz: 'Solenoid valve' — elektr signal bilan ochilib-yopiladigan kichik klapan. U ko'pincha katta klapanlarni boshqaruvchi 'pilot' vazifasini bajaradi.
en: A 'solenoid valve' is a small valve opened/closed by an electric signal. It often acts as a 'pilot' controlling larger valves.

uz: Solenoid klapan ichida elektromagnit bor — tok berilsa u pistonchani tortadi va klapan holatini o'zgartiradi.
en: A solenoid valve contains an electromagnet — when energized it pulls a plunger and changes the valve's state.

uz: 'Check valve' (qaytmas klapan) suyuqlikni faqat bir yo'nalishda o'tkazadi. U orqaga oqishni to'sib, nasos va jihozlarni himoya qiladi.
en: A 'check valve' lets fluid pass in only one direction. It blocks backflow, protecting pumps and equipment.

uz: SAVOL: 'Check valve' nima vazifani bajaradi? JAVOB: Suyuqlikni faqat bir yo'nalishda o'tkazib, orqaga (teskari) oqishni to'sadi.
en: Q: What does a check valve do? A: It lets fluid flow only one way, blocking reverse (back) flow.

uz: 'Relief valve' (himoya klapani) bosim xavfli darajaga chiqsa, o'z-o'zidan ochilib ortiqcha bosimni chiqaradi. U portlashning oldini oladi.
en: A 'relief valve' opens by itself when pressure rises to a dangerous level, releasing excess pressure. It prevents explosions.

uz: Relief klapani ma'lum bosimda ochiladigan qilib sozlanadi — u tizimning 'xavfsizlik qopqog'i' vazifasini bajaradi.
en: A relief valve is set to open at a specific pressure — acting as the system's 'safety cap'.

uz: SAVOL: 'Relief valve' qachon ochiladi? JAVOB: Bosim xavfli sozlangan darajaga yetganda — ortiqcha bosimni chiqarib portlashni oldini oladi.
en: Q: When does a relief valve open? A: When pressure reaches a dangerous set level — releasing excess pressure to prevent an explosion.

uz: 'Heat exchanger' (issiqlik almashtirgich) ikki suyuqlik orasida issiqlikni ular aralashmasdan uzatadi. Stansiyada ular hamma joyda: coolerlar, kondensator, HRSG.
en: A heat exchanger transfers heat between two fluids without mixing them. They're everywhere in a plant: coolers, condenser, HRSG.

uz: 'Shell-and-tube' issiqlik almashtirgichda bir suyuqlik quvurlar ichidan, ikkinchisi ular atrofidan oqadi — issiqlik quvur devori orqali o'tadi.
en: In a 'shell-and-tube' heat exchanger, one fluid flows inside tubes and another around them — heat passes through the tube walls.

uz: 'Fouling' — issiqlik almashtirgich yuzasida cho'kma to'planib, issiqlik o'tishini yomonlashtirishi. Davriy tozalash uni bartaraf etadi.
en: 'Fouling' is deposit buildup on heat exchanger surfaces, worsening heat transfer. Periodic cleaning removes it.

uz: SAVOL: Issiqlik almashtirgich nima qiladi? JAVOB: Ikki suyuqlik orasida issiqlikni ular aralashmasdan uzatadi.
en: Q: What does a heat exchanger do? A: It transfers heat between two fluids without letting them mix.

uz: 'Centrifugal pump' (markazdan qochma nasos) aylanuvchi g'ildirak (impeller) bilan suyuqlikni tashqariga uloqtirib, bosim hosil qiladi. Stansiyadagi eng keng tarqalgan nasos.
en: A centrifugal pump uses a spinning impeller to fling liquid outward, creating pressure. It's the most common pump in a plant.

uz: 'Cavitation' — nasos ichida bosim juda pasayib, suyuqlikda bug' pufakchalari hosil bo'lishi. Ular portlab, nasosni yeydi va shovqin chiqaradi.
en: 'Cavitation' is when pressure inside a pump drops so low that vapor bubbles form in the liquid. They implode, eroding the pump and making noise.

uz: SAVOL: Nasosdagi 'cavitation' nima va nega zararli? JAVOB: Bosim pasayib bug' pufakchalari hosil bo'ladi; ular portlab nasosni yeydi.
en: Q: What is pump cavitation and why is it harmful? A: Low pressure forms vapor bubbles that implode and erode the pump.

uz: 'NPSH' (Net Positive Suction Head) — nasos so'rish tomonida cavitationdan qochish uchun kerak bo'lgan minimal bosim. Uni ta'minlash muhim.
en: NPSH (Net Positive Suction Head) is the minimum pressure needed at a pump's suction to avoid cavitation. Ensuring it is important.

uz: Nasosga issiq suyuqlik (masalan qaynash haroratiga yaqin suv) berilsa cavitation xavfi ortadi — shuning uchun so'rish bosimi yetarli bo'lishi kerak.
en: Feeding a pump hot liquid (e.g. water near boiling) raises cavitation risk — so suction pressure must be sufficient.

uz: 'Fan' va 'blower' havoni harakatga keltiradi. Ventilyatorlar sovutish, tortish (draft) va ventilyatsiya uchun stansiyada ko'p ishlatiladi.
en: Fans and blowers move air. They're widely used in a plant for cooling, draft and ventilation.

uz: SAVOL: NPSH nima uchun muhim? JAVOB: Nasos so'rishida yetarli bosim bo'lmasa cavitation boshlanadi va nasos shikastlanadi.
en: Q: Why is NPSH important? A: Without enough suction pressure, cavitation begins and damages the pump.

uz: 'Damper' va 'louver' havo yoki gaz oqimini rostlaydigan burilma plastinkalar. Ular ventilyatsiya va chiqindi tizimida oqimni boshqaradi.
en: 'Dampers' and 'louvers' are pivoting plates that regulate air or gas flow. They control flow in ventilation and exhaust systems.

uz: 'Draft' — mo'ridagi havo/gaz oqimini haydovchi bosim farqi. 'Forced draft' ventilyator havoni itaradi, 'induced draft' esa tortadi.
en: 'Draft' is the pressure difference driving air/gas flow in a stack. A 'forced draft' fan pushes air, an 'induced draft' fan pulls it.

uz: 'Silencer' (shovqin pasaytirgich) turbina kirish va chiqishidagi kuchli shovqinni kamaytiradi. U tovush to'lqinlarini yutuvchi materiallardan iborat.
en: A 'silencer' reduces the loud noise at a turbine's inlet and exhaust. It's made of sound-absorbing materials.

uz: SAVOL: 'Forced draft' va 'induced draft' farqi nima? JAVOB: Forced draft havoni itaradi (kirishda), induced draft esa tortadi (chiqishda).
en: Q: What's the difference between forced and induced draft? A: Forced draft pushes air (at inlet), induced draft pulls it (at outlet).

uz: Stansiya shovqini nazorat qilinadi — turbina, transformator va ventilyatorlar shovqin chiqaradi. Shovqin himoyasi ishchilar salomatligi uchun muhim.
en: Plant noise is controlled — turbines, transformers and fans produce noise. Noise protection matters for worker health.

uz: Yuqori shovqinli hududlarda quloq himoyasi majburiy — uzoq muddat kuchli shovqin eshitishga zarar yetkazadi.
en: Hearing protection is mandatory in high-noise areas — prolonged loud noise damages hearing.

uz: 'Grounding grid' — stansiya ostidagi yer ostiga ko'milgan metall to'r. U nosozlik tokini yerga tarqatib, xavfsiz kuchlanishni ta'minlaydi.
en: A 'grounding grid' is a metal mesh buried under the plant. It disperses fault current into the earth, ensuring safe voltages.

uz: Yaxshi yerlashtirish nosozlik paytida odam turgan joyda xavfli 'qadam kuchlanishi' (step voltage) paydo bo'lishining oldini oladi.
en: Good grounding prevents dangerous 'step voltage' at a person's feet during a fault.

uz: SAVOL: 'Grounding grid' nima vazifani bajaradi? JAVOB: Nosozlik tokini yerga xavfsiz tarqatib, xavfli kuchlanishlarning oldini oladi.
en: Q: What does a grounding grid do? A: It safely disperses fault current into the earth, preventing dangerous voltages.

uz: 'SCADA' — masofadan nazorat va ma'lumot yig'ish tizimi. U operatorlarga stansiyani (yoki ko'p stansiyani) markazdan kuzatish imkonini beradi.
en: SCADA is a supervisory control and data acquisition system. It lets operators monitor a plant (or many plants) centrally from a distance.

uz: SCADA va DCS birga ishlaydi: DCS jarayonni real vaqtda boshqaradi, SCADA esa umumiy kuzatuv va ma'lumot yig'ish uchun.
en: SCADA and DCS work together: DCS controls the process in real time, while SCADA provides overall supervision and data collection.

uz: 'Historian' — stansiya ma'lumotlarini yillar davomida saqlaydigan ma'lumotlar bazasi. U nosozlik tahlili va samaradorlikni yaxshilashda ishlatiladi.
en: A 'historian' is a database storing plant data over years. It's used for fault analysis and improving performance.

uz: SAVOL: SCADA tizimi nima imkon beradi? JAVOB: Stansiyani (yoki ko'p stansiyani) masofadan markazlashgan holda kuzatish va ma'lumot yig'ishni.
en: Q: What does a SCADA system enable? A: Remote, centralized monitoring and data collection for a plant (or many plants).

uz: 'Cyber security' zamonaviy stansiyalarda muhim — DCS va SCADA tizimlari tashqi hujumlardan himoyalanadi, chunki ular jismoniy jihozni boshqaradi.
en: Cyber security matters in modern plants — DCS and SCADA systems are protected from external attacks, since they control physical equipment.

uz: Muhim boshqaruv tizimlari ko'pincha internetdan ajratiladi ('air gap') — bu masofadan buzg'unchilikning oldini oladi.
en: Critical control systems are often isolated from the internet (an 'air gap') — preventing remote intrusion.

uz: 'Commissioning' — yangi stansiyani ishga tushirishdan oldin har bir tizimni sinab, sozlab, tekshirish jarayoni. U oylab davom etadi.
en: 'Commissioning' is testing, tuning and verifying every system before a new plant enters service. It can take months.

uz: 'Performance test' — stansiya kafolatlangan quvvat va FIKga erishganini rasmiy o'lchash. U qabul qilish (acceptance) uchun muhim.
en: A 'performance test' formally measures whether a plant achieves its guaranteed power and efficiency. It's key for acceptance.

uz: SAVOL: 'Commissioning' nima? JAVOB: Yangi stansiyani ishga tushirishdan oldin har bir tizimni sinab, sozlab tekshirish jarayoni.
en: Q: What is commissioning? A: The process of testing, tuning and verifying every system before a new plant enters service.

uz: Gaz turbinasi rotori bitta uzun val — unda kompressor va turbina qismlari birga o'rnatilgan. Ular bir tezlikda, bir yo'nalishda aylanadi.
en: A gas turbine rotor is one long shaft carrying both the compressor and turbine sections. They rotate together at one speed, in one direction.

uz: Gaz turbinasida foydali quvvat = turbina ishlab chiqargan quvvat minus kompressorga sarflangan quvvat. Kompressor 'ochko'ziroq' bo'lsa, foydali quvvat kamayadi.
en: In a gas turbine, useful power = turbine power minus compressor power. The 'greedier' the compressor, the less useful power remains.

uz: SAVOL: Gaz turbinasida foydali quvvat qanday hisoblanadi? JAVOB: Turbina ishlab chiqargan quvvatdan kompressorga sarflangan quvvat ayriladi.
en: Q: How is useful power found in a gas turbine? A: Compressor power is subtracted from the power the turbine produces.

uz: Kompressorda havo bosqichma-bosqich siqiladi. Har bosqichda bosim biroz oshadi, harorat ham ko'tariladi — chiqishda havo juda issiq va zich bo'ladi.
en: Air is compressed stage by stage. Each stage raises pressure a little and temperature too — the air leaves very hot and dense.

uz: Kompressor chiqishidagi havo harorati faqat siqilishdan 400°C dan oshishi mumkin — hali yoqilg'i yonmasidan oldin.
en: Compressor discharge air can exceed 400°C from compression alone — even before any fuel is burned.

uz: SAVOL: Nega kompressor chiqishida havo issiq bo'ladi? JAVOB: Siqilish gazni qizdiradi — bosim oshgani sari harorat ham ko'tariladi.
en: Q: Why is air hot at the compressor exit? A: Compression heats a gas — as pressure rises, so does temperature.

uz: Yonish kamerasiga kompressordan issiq, siqilgan havo keladi va unga yoqilg'i qo'shib yoqiladi. Bu gazni yanada qizdirib, energiyasini oshiradi.
en: The combustor receives hot, compressed air from the compressor, adds fuel and burns it. This further heats the gas, raising its energy.

uz: Yonish kamerasida faqat yoqilg'ining bir qismini yoqishga havo ishlatiladi; qolgan havo alangani sovutish va gazni aralashtirishga ketadi.
en: Only part of the air in a combustor is used to burn fuel; the rest cools the flame and mixes the gas.

uz: SAVOL: Yonish kamerasidagi havoning hammasi yoqilg'i yonishiga ketadimi? JAVOB: Yo'q — bir qismi yonishga, ko'p qismi alangani sovutish va gazni aralashtirishga ketadi.
en: Q: Is all combustor air used to burn fuel? A: No — some burns fuel, but much cools the flame and mixes the gas.

uz: Turbina qismida issiq gaz kengayadi va pichoqlarni aylantiradi. Bu aylanish valni, val esa ham kompressorni, ham generatorni harakatga keltiradi.
en: In the turbine section hot gas expands and spins the blades. This rotation turns the shaft, which drives both the compressor and the generator.

uz: Turbina birinchi bosqich pichoqlari eng issiq gazga duchor bo'ladi — shuning uchun ular eng ko'p sovutiladigan va eng qimmat qismlardir.
en: The turbine's first-stage blades face the hottest gas — so they are the most heavily cooled and most expensive parts.

uz: SAVOL: Turbinaning qaysi pichoqlari eng qattiq issiqlikka duchor bo'ladi? JAVOB: Birinchi bosqich pichoqlari — ular eng issiq gaz oqimini birinchi qabul qiladi.
en: Q: Which turbine blades face the fiercest heat? A: The first-stage blades — they meet the hottest gas flow first.

uz: Gaz turbinasi vali to'g'ridan-to'g'ri generatorga ulanadi (yoki reduktor orqali). Turbina aylanishi generatorda elektr hosil qiladi.
en: The gas turbine shaft connects directly to the generator (or via a gearbox). The turbine's rotation produces electricity in the generator.

uz: 50 Hz to'r uchun 2 qutbli generator 3000 ayl/min da aylanishi kerak — gaz turbinasi aynan shu tezlikda ishlaydi, shu bois to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ulanadi.
en: For a 50 Hz grid a 2-pole generator must spin at 3000 rpm — a gas turbine runs at exactly this speed, so it connects directly.

uz: SAVOL: Nega gaz turbinasi generatorga ko'pincha to'g'ridan-to'g'ri (reduktorsiz) ulanadi? JAVOB: Uning tezligi (3000 ayl/min) 50 Hz generator uchun aynan mos keladi.
en: Q: Why does a gas turbine often connect directly (no gearbox) to the generator? A: Its speed (3000 rpm) exactly suits a 50 Hz generator.

uz: Gaz turbinasidan chiqqan ~600°C gaz HRSG'ga kiradi. Bu issiqlik suvni qizdirib, bug'ga aylantiradi — combined cycle'ning ikkinchi bosqichi shu.
en: The ~600°C gas leaving the gas turbine enters the HRSG. This heat warms water into steam — the second stage of combined cycle.

uz: HRSG'siz gaz turbinasi issiqligining katta qismi mo'ridan behuda uchib ketardi. HRSG shu issiqlikni 'ushlab', qo'shimcha elektr ishlab chiqaradi.
en: Without an HRSG, much of the gas turbine's heat would escape uselessly up the stack. The HRSG captures it to make extra electricity.

uz: SAVOL: HRSG combined cycle FIKini qanday oshiradi? JAVOB: Gaz turbinasining chiqindi issiqligini bug' hosil qilishga ishlatib, qo'shimcha quvvat oladi.
en: Q: How does an HRSG raise combined cycle efficiency? A: It uses the gas turbine's waste heat to raise steam, producing extra power.

uz: HRSG'da hosil bo'lgan bug' bug' turbinasiga boradi va uni aylantiradi. Bug' turbinasi ham o'z generatorini (yoki bir vali) harakatga keltiradi.
en: Steam made in the HRSG goes to the steam turbine and spins it. The steam turbine also drives its own generator (or a shared shaft).

uz: Ba'zi stansiyalarda gaz va bug' turbinasi bitta valda — 'single shaft'. Ular bitta generatorni birga harakatga keltiradi.
en: In some plants the gas and steam turbines share one shaft — 'single shaft'. They drive a single generator together.

uz: SAVOL: 'Single shaft' combined cycle nima degani? JAVOB: Gaz va bug' turbinasi bitta valda joylashib, bitta generatorni birga harakatga keltiradi.
en: Q: What is a 'single shaft' combined cycle? A: The gas and steam turbines sit on one shaft, driving a single generator together.

uz: Gaz turbinasi podshipniklari juda yuqori tezlikda va yukda ishlaydi. Ular doimiy moy oqimi bilan sovutilib-moylanadi, aks holda bir necha soniyada ishdan chiqadi.
en: Gas turbine bearings run at very high speed and load. They are continuously cooled and lubricated by oil flow — without it they'd fail in seconds.

uz: Moy tizimida bak, nasoslar, sovutgichlar va filtrlar bor. Moy podshipniklardan qizib qaytadi, sovutiladi, filtrlanadi va yana haydaladi.
en: The oil system has a tank, pumps, coolers and filters. Oil returns hot from the bearings, is cooled, filtered and pumped again.

uz: SAVOL: Moy podshipnikda ikki vazifani bajaradi — qaysilar? JAVOB: Moylash (ishqalanishni kamaytirish) va sovutish (issiqlikni olib chiqish).
en: Q: What two jobs does oil do in a bearing? A: Lubrication (reducing friction) and cooling (carrying heat away).

uz: Generatordan chiqqan elektr avval 'generator circuit breaker' orqali o'tadi, keyin step-up transformatorda kuchlanishi oshiriladi va to'rga uzatiladi.
en: Power from the generator first passes through a generator circuit breaker, then its voltage is raised in the step-up transformer and sent to the grid.

uz: 'Generator circuit breaker' generatorni to'rdan tez ajratishga imkon beradi — bu nosozlik yoki texnik xizmat paytida muhim.
en: A generator circuit breaker allows quickly isolating the generator from the grid — important during a fault or maintenance.

uz: SAVOL: Generator elektri to'rga borishdan oldin qayerdan o'tadi? JAVOB: Generator circuit breaker'dan, keyin step-up transformatordan (kuchlanish oshiriladi).
en: Q: What does generator power pass through before reaching the grid? A: The generator circuit breaker, then the step-up transformer (voltage raised).

uz: Ishga tushirishda ketma-ketlik: rotorni aylantirish (SFC) → purge → yoqish (ignition) → tezlashtirish → sinxronizatsiya → yuklama berish. Har qadam tekshiriladi.
en: The startup sequence: spin the rotor (SFC) → purge → ignition → accelerate → synchronize → apply load. Each step is verified.

uz: Sinxronizatsiya lahzasi juda muhim — generator chastotasi, kuchlanishi va fazasi to'rga aniq mos kelganda circuit breaker ulanadi.
en: The moment of synchronization is critical — the breaker closes only when the generator's frequency, voltage and phase exactly match the grid.

uz: SAVOL: Gaz turbinasi ishga tushirishda 'purge' qaysi qadamda bo'ladi? JAVOB: Rotorni aylantirishdan keyin, yoqish (ignition)dan oldin — yonuvchi gazni tozalash uchun.
en: Q: In gas turbine startup, when does 'purge' happen? A: After spinning the rotor and before ignition — to clear combustible gas.

uz: Gaz turbinasiga kirayotgan havo katta hajmda — u avval filtr, keyin silencer (shovqin pasaytirgich) va duct (kanal) orqali kompressorga boradi.
en: The air entering a gas turbine is large in volume — it first passes a filter, then a silencer and duct before reaching the compressor.

uz: Kirish havo tizimidagi bosim yo'qotishlari (filtr, kanal) turbina quvvatini biroz kamaytiradi — shuning uchun ular past qarshilikli qilib loyihalanadi.
en: Pressure losses in the inlet air path (filter, duct) slightly reduce turbine power — so they are designed for low resistance.

uz: SAVOL: Kirish havo yo'lidagi filtr va kanal turbina quvvatiga qanday ta'sir qiladi? JAVOB: Bosim yo'qotishi tufayli quvvatni biroz kamaytiradi, shu bois past qarshilikli qilinadi.
en: Q: How do the inlet filter and duct affect turbine power? A: Their pressure loss slightly reduces power, so they're built for low resistance.

uz: Gaz turbinasi chiqindi gazi HRSG'ga borishdan oldin 'diffuser' orqali o'tadi — u oqimni sekinlashtirib, bosimni tiklaydi va energiyani tejaydi.
en: Gas turbine exhaust passes through a 'diffuser' before the HRSG — it slows the flow, recovers pressure and saves energy.

uz: Kompressordan olingan sovutuvchi havo turbina disklari va pichoqlarini sovutadi — bu havo keyin asosiy gaz oqimiga qo'shilib ketadi.
en: Cooling air taken from the compressor cools turbine discs and blades — this air then rejoins the main gas flow.

uz: SAVOL: Turbinani sovutgan havo qayerga boradi? JAVOB: U asosiy gaz oqimiga qo'shilib, chiqindi bilan birga HRSG tomon ketadi.
en: Q: Where does the air that cooled the turbine go? A: It rejoins the main gas flow and heads toward the HRSG with the exhaust.

uz: GT boshqaruv tizimi yuzlab datchikdan (harorat, bosim, tezlik, vibratsiya) ma'lumot oladi va yoqilg'i, IGV, klapanlarni real vaqtda boshqaradi.
en: The GT control system reads hundreds of sensors (temperature, pressure, speed, vibration) and manages fuel, IGVs and valves in real time.

uz: Chiqindi gaz harorati (EGT/exhaust temperature) gaz turbinasi 'sog'lig'ining' asosiy ko'rsatkichi — boshqaruv uni chegaradan oshirmaydi.
en: Exhaust gas temperature (EGT) is a key indicator of gas turbine 'health' — the control system keeps it below limits.

uz: SAVOL: GT boshqaruv tizimi nima asosida yoqilg'ini rostlaydi? JAVOB: Yuzlab datchik (harorat, tezlik, bosim) ma'lumoti asosida, real vaqtda.
en: Q: On what basis does the GT control system regulate fuel? A: On data from hundreds of sensors (temperature, speed, pressure), in real time.

uz: Gaz turbinasi rejali ta'mir tsikli 'operating hours' va 'starts' ga bog'liq — qaysi biri avval chegaraga yetsa, o'sha inspection vaqtini belgilaydi.
en: A gas turbine's maintenance interval depends on both operating hours and starts — whichever reaches its limit first sets the inspection time.

uz: 'Hot gas path inspection' — turbinaning eng issiq qismlarini (pichoq, transition piece) ko'zdan kechirish va almashtirish. Bu eng muhim ta'mir turlaridan.
en: A 'hot gas path inspection' examines and replaces the turbine's hottest parts (blades, transition pieces). It's among the most important overhauls.

uz: SAVOL: Gaz turbinasi ta'mir vaqtini nima belgilaydi? JAVOB: Ishlagan soatlar yoki startlar soni — qaysi biri avval chegaraga yetsa.
en: Q: What determines a gas turbine's maintenance timing? A: Operating hours or number of starts — whichever reaches its limit first.

uz: GTCC stansiyasida gaz turbinasi umumiy quvvatning ~2/3 qismini, bug' turbinasi ~1/3 qismini beradi — bir yoqilg'idan ikki manba.
en: In a GTCC plant the gas turbine provides ~2/3 of total power and the steam turbine ~1/3 — two sources from one fuel.

uz: Bug' turbinasi qo'shimcha yoqilg'i yoqmasdan quvvat beradi — u faqat gaz turbinasining 'bepul' chiqindi issiqligidan foydalanadi.
en: The steam turbine produces power without burning extra fuel — it uses only the 'free' waste heat of the gas turbine.

uz: SAVOL: GTCC'da bug' turbinasi qancha quvvat beradi (taxminan)? JAVOB: Umumiy quvvatning taxminan uchdan bir qismini, qo'shimcha yoqilg'isiz.
en: Q: About how much power does the steam turbine give in a GTCC? A: Roughly one-third of total, without extra fuel.

uz: Bug' turbinasidan chiqqan bug' kondensatorda sovib suvga aylanadi. Bu suv qaytadan HRSG'ga haydaladi — yopiq sikl, suv behuda ketmaydi.
en: Steam leaving the steam turbine condenses to water in the condenser. This water is pumped back to the HRSG — a closed loop, no water wasted.

uz: Kondensatordagi vakuum bug'ning ko'proq kengayishiga imkon beradi — bu bug' turbinasidan olinadigan quvvatni sezilarli oshiradi.
en: The vacuum in the condenser lets steam expand more — this significantly increases the power extracted from the steam turbine.

uz: SAVOL: Kondensatdan keyin suv qayerga boradi? JAVOB: Qaytadan HRSG'ga haydaladi — sikl yopiq, suv qayta-qayta ishlatiladi.
en: Q: Where does water go after condensing? A: It is pumped back to the HRSG — the loop is closed, water is reused.

uz: Elektr energiya deyarli saqlanmaydi — u ishlab chiqarilgan zahoti iste'mol qilinadi. Shuning uchun stansiyalar talabga qarab real vaqtda quvvatni moslaydi.
en: Electricity is barely storable — it is consumed the instant it's generated. So plants adjust output to demand in real time.

uz: SAVOL: Nega stansiyalar quvvatni doimiy moslab turadi? JAVOB: Elektr saqlanmaydi — ishlab chiqarish va iste'mol har lahzada teng bo'lishi kerak.
en: Q: Why do plants constantly adjust output? A: Electricity isn't stored — generation and consumption must match every instant.

uz: IGV (Inlet Guide Vanes) kompressor kirishida joylashib, havo miqdorini rostlaydi. Ishga tushirishda yopiq, to'liq quvvatda ochiq holatga keladi.
en: IGVs sit at the compressor inlet and regulate airflow. They are closed at startup and open toward full-power operation.

uz: IGV yopiq bo'lganda kam havo kiradi — bu ishga tushirishda kompressor 'surge'ining oldini oladi va yumshoq start beradi.
en: With IGVs closed, less air enters — this prevents compressor surge at startup and gives a smooth start.

uz: SAVOL: IGV ishga tushirishda nega yopiq turadi? JAVOB: Havoni cheklab, kompressor surge'ining oldini olish va yumshoq start berish uchun.
en: Q: Why are IGVs closed during startup? A: To limit air, prevent compressor surge and give a smooth start.

uz: Part-load (qisman quvvat)da IGV havo oqimini kamaytiradi — bu chiqindi gaz haroratini yuqori ushlab, HRSG samaradorligini saqlaydi.
en: At part-load the IGVs reduce airflow — this keeps exhaust temperature high, maintaining HRSG efficiency.

uz: IGV yordamida combined cycle qisman quvvatda ham yuqori FIK saqlaydi — bug' turbinasi issiq gazdan yetarli bug' oladi.
en: Thanks to IGVs, combined cycle keeps high efficiency even at part-load — the steam turbine still gets enough hot gas for steam.

uz: Gaz turbinasi 'firing temperature' — turbinaga kirayotgan gaz harorati. U qancha yuqori bo'lsa, FIK va quvvat shuncha yuqori, lekin materiallar shuncha sinovda.
en: A gas turbine's 'firing temperature' is the gas temperature entering the turbine. Higher means more efficiency and power, but greater material stress.

uz: J-class turbinalar firing temperaturani ~1600°C ga ko'targani uchun rekord FIK beradi — bu ilg'or sovutish va materiallar tufayli mumkin bo'ldi.
en: J-class turbines reach a ~1600°C firing temperature, giving record efficiency — made possible by advanced cooling and materials.

uz: SAVOL: 'Firing temperature' oshsa nima yutuq va nima xavf? JAVOB: Yutuq — yuqori FIK va quvvat; xavf — materiallarga ko'proq issiqlik yuki.
en: Q: What's the gain and risk of higher firing temperature? A: Gain — more efficiency and power; risk — greater thermal load on materials.

uz: DLN (Dry Low NOx) combustor yoqilg'ini havo bilan oldindan aralashtirib yoqadi. Bu 'premix' yonish alangani sovuqroq va tekisroq qiladi, NOx kamayadi.
en: A DLN (Dry Low NOx) combustor pre-mixes fuel with air before burning. This 'premix' combustion makes the flame cooler and more even, lowering NOx.

uz: NOx (azot oksidi) juda yuqori haroratli alangada ko'proq hosil bo'ladi — shuning uchun DLN alangani nazorat ostida sovuqroq ushlaydi.
en: NOx (nitrogen oxides) forms more in very hot flames — so DLN keeps the flame controlled and cooler.

uz: SAVOL: DLN combustor NOx'ni qanday kamaytiradi? JAVOB: Yoqilg'ini oldindan havo bilan aralashtirib, tekis va sovuqroq alanga hosil qiladi.
en: Q: How does a DLN combustor reduce NOx? A: By pre-mixing fuel with air to make an even, cooler flame.

uz: 'Combustion dynamics' — yonish kamerasidagi bosim tebranishlari. Kuchli tebranish qismlarni yorib yuborishi mumkin, shuning uchun u kuzatiladi va nazorat qilinadi.
en: 'Combustion dynamics' are pressure oscillations in the combustor. Strong oscillations can crack parts, so they are monitored and controlled.

uz: Premix yonish samarali, lekin 'combustion dynamics'ga moyil — shuning uchun DLN turbinalarda bosim tebranishi doimiy nazoratda bo'ladi.
en: Premix combustion is efficient but prone to combustion dynamics — so pressure oscillation is continuously monitored in DLN turbines.

uz: Generator ichida rotor aylanib magnit maydon yaratadi, statordagi mis o'ramlarda esa elektr toki 'induksiya' qilinadi. Bu Faradey qonuni asosida ishlaydi.
en: Inside a generator the rotor spins to create a magnetic field, and current is 'induced' in the stator's copper windings. This works by Faraday's law.

uz: Generator quvvatini oshirish uchun rotorga ko'proq magnitlash toki (excitation) beriladi — bu kuchliroq magnit maydon va yuqori kuchlanish demakdir.
en: To raise generator output, more magnetizing (excitation) current is fed to the rotor — meaning a stronger field and higher voltage.

uz: SAVOL: Generatorda tok qaysi qismda hosil bo'ladi? JAVOB: Statorda (qo'zg'almas o'ramlarda) — aylanuvchi rotor magnit maydoni orqali induksiya qiladi.
en: Q: In which part of a generator is current produced? A: In the stator (stationary windings) — induced by the rotating rotor's magnetic field.

uz: Katta generator juda ko'p issiqlik chiqaradi. Sovutish uchun ichida vodorod yoki havo yopiq aylanadi va cooler'da soviydi.
en: A large generator produces a lot of heat. For cooling, hydrogen or air circulates inside in a closed loop and is cooled in a cooler.

uz: Vodorod bilan sovutish samaraliroq va shovqinni kamaytiradi, lekin vodorod portlovchi bo'lgani uchun zichlash va xavfsizlik tizimlari juda muhim.
en: Hydrogen cooling is more effective and reduces windage noise, but since hydrogen is explosive, sealing and safety systems are critical.

uz: Generatorni himoya qiluvchi relelar ko'p turdagi nosozlikni kuzatadi: qisqa tutashuv, ortiqcha tok, teskari quvvat, yer bilan tutashuv va h.k.
en: Relays protecting a generator watch for many fault types: short circuit, overcurrent, reverse power, earth fault and more.

uz: 'Reverse power' himoyasi generator motor bo'lib qolishini sezadi — agar turbina quvvat bermay qolsa, generator to'rdan tok tortib aylanaveradi, bu xavfli.
en: Reverse power protection detects the generator becoming a motor — if the turbine stops driving it, the generator draws power from the grid, which is dangerous.

uz: SAVOL: 'Reverse power' himoyasi nimani sezadi? JAVOB: Turbina quvvat bermay qolib, generator to'rdan tok tortib motor bo'lib qolishini.
en: Q: What does reverse power protection detect? A: The turbine ceasing to drive the generator, so it draws power from the grid and acts as a motor.

uz: 'Differential protection' generator yoki transformatorga kirayotgan va chiqayotgan tokni solishtiradi. Farq bo'lsa — ichkarida nosozlik bor, darhol uziladi.
en: Differential protection compares current entering and leaving a generator or transformer. A difference means an internal fault — it trips instantly.

uz: SAVOL: 'Differential protection' qanday ishlaydi? JAVOB: Kirish va chiqish tokini solishtiradi — farq bo'lsa ichki nosozlik deb uzadi.
en: Q: How does differential protection work? A: It compares input and output current — a mismatch signals an internal fault and it trips.

uz: Podshipnikda val to'g'ridan-to'g'ri metallga tegmaydi — u yupqa bosimli moy pardasida 'suzadi'. Bu 'hydrodynamic' moylash deb ataladi.
en: In a bearing the shaft never touches metal directly — it 'floats' on a thin pressurized oil film. This is called hydrodynamic lubrication.

uz: Ishga tushirishda val sekin aylanadi va moy pardasi hali zaif — shuning uchun ba'zi turbinalarda 'jacking oil' yuqori bosimli moy valni ko'taradi.
en: At startup the shaft turns slowly and the oil film is weak — so some turbines use high-pressure 'jacking oil' to lift the shaft.

uz: SAVOL: 'Jacking oil' nima uchun kerak? JAVOB: Sekin aylanishda (start/stop) valni ko'tarib, metall-metall tegishning oldini olish uchun.
en: Q: Why is 'jacking oil' needed? A: To lift the shaft at low speed (start/stop) and prevent metal-to-metal contact.

uz: HRSG ko'p bosimli bo'ladi: HP (yuqori), IP (o'rta), LP (past). Har bosim darajasi chiqindi gaz issiqligining turli qismidan foydalanadi.
en: An HRSG is multi-pressure: HP (high), IP (intermediate), LP (low). Each pressure level uses a different portion of the exhaust heat.

uz: Ko'p bosimli HRSG chiqindi gaz issiqligidan maksimal foydalanadi — issiqroq gaz HP bug' hosil qiladi, sovuqroq gaz LP bug' va suvni isitadi.
en: A multi-pressure HRSG extracts the most from exhaust heat — hotter gas makes HP steam, cooler gas makes LP steam and heats water.

uz: SAVOL: Nega HRSG ko'p bosim darajasida ishlaydi (HP/IP/LP)? JAVOB: Chiqindi gaz issiqligidan imkon qadar ko'proq foydalanish uchun — har daraja gazning turli qismini oladi.
en: Q: Why does an HRSG use multiple pressure levels (HP/IP/LP)? A: To extract as much exhaust heat as possible — each level uses a different part of the gas.

uz: Bug' turbinasi HP, IP va LP bosqichlardan iborat. Bug' avval HP'da, keyin qayta qizdirilib IP'da, oxirida LP'da kengayadi.
en: A steam turbine has HP, IP and LP sections. Steam expands first in HP, then (after reheating) in IP, and finally in LP.

uz: Bug' LP bosqichida eng ko'p kengayadi — shuning uchun LP pichoqlari eng uzun (metrga yaqin) va turbinaning eng katta qismi.
en: Steam expands most in the LP section — so LP blades are the longest (nearly a meter) and the biggest part of the turbine.

uz: SAVOL: Nega bug' turbinasi LP pichoqlari eng uzun bo'ladi? JAVOB: Past bosimda bug' hajmi juda katta — uni qabul qilish uchun katta pichoqlar kerak.
en: Q: Why are steam turbine LP blades the longest? A: At low pressure steam volume is huge — large blades are needed to handle it.

uz: Combined cycle ishga tushishi bosqichma-bosqich: avval gaz turbinasi, keyin HRSG bug' hosil qiladi, oxirida bug' turbinasi qo'shiladi. To'liq quvvatga chiqish vaqt oladi.
en: A combined cycle starts in stages: first the gas turbine, then the HRSG raises steam, finally the steam turbine joins. Reaching full power takes time.

uz: Bug' turbinasi ishga tushishi uchun HRSG yetarli bug' hosil qilishi kerak — shuning uchun u gaz turbinasidan keyin, biroz kechroq qo'shiladi.
en: The steam turbine needs the HRSG to raise enough steam first — so it joins a bit later, after the gas turbine.

uz: SAVOL: Combined cycle'da nega bug' turbinasi gaz turbinasidan keyin ishga tushadi? JAVOB: Avval HRSG bug' hosil qilishi kerak, buning uchun gaz turbinasi issiq gaz berishi lozim.
en: Q: Why does the steam turbine start after the gas turbine in a combined cycle? A: The HRSG must first raise steam, which needs the gas turbine's hot gas.

uz: Yoqilg'i gaz tizimi gazni filtrlaydi, bosimini rostlaydi va isitadi. Toza, to'g'ri bosimli, iliq gaz barqaror yonishni ta'minlaydi.
en: The fuel gas system filters the gas, regulates its pressure and heats it. Clean, correctly pressured, warm gas ensures stable combustion.

uz: Yoqilg'i gaz isitilganda uning energiyasining bir qismi combined cycle issiqligidan olinadi — bu FIKni yanada oshiradi ('fuel gas heating').
en: When fuel gas is heated, part of that heat comes from the combined cycle itself — this further raises efficiency ('fuel gas heating').

uz: SAVOL: Yoqilg'i gaz tizimi gazni qanday tayyorlaydi? JAVOB: Filtrlaydi, bosimini rostlaydi va isitadi — barqaror yonish uchun.
en: Q: How does the fuel gas system prepare the gas? A: It filters, regulates pressure and heats it — for stable combustion.

uz: 'Boiler feed pump' HRSG'ga suvni yuqori bosim ostida haydaydi. U stansiyadagi eng quvvatli va muhim nasoslardan biri.
en: The boiler feed pump forces water into the HRSG at high pressure. It's one of the most powerful and critical pumps in the plant.

uz: Feed pump ishlamay qolsa, HRSG suvsiz qolib quvurlari kuyishi mumkin — shuning uchun ko'pincha zaxira feed pump bo'ladi.
en: If the feed pump fails, the HRSG could run dry and its tubes overheat — so a backup feed pump is usually provided.

uz: SAVOL: 'Boiler feed pump' nima qiladi? JAVOB: Suvni yuqori bosim ostida HRSG'ga haydab, bug' hosil bo'lishini ta'minlaydi.
en: Q: What does the boiler feed pump do? A: It forces water into the HRSG at high pressure so steam can be raised.

uz: Stansiya DCS (Distributed Control System) orqali boshqariladi. Operatorlar nazorat xonasidagi ekranlar orqali butun stansiyani kuzatadi va boshqaradi.
en: The plant is run through a DCS (Distributed Control System). Operators monitor and control the whole plant via screens in the control room.

uz: DCS minglab nuqtani (harorat, bosim, klapan holati) real vaqtda ko'rsatadi va ko'p jarayonni avtomatik boshqaradi — operator faqat nazorat qiladi.
en: A DCS displays thousands of points (temperature, pressure, valve position) in real time and automates many processes — the operator mainly supervises.

uz: SAVOL: DCS operatorga nima imkon beradi? JAVOB: Butun stansiyani nazorat xonasidan, ekranlar orqali kuzatish va boshqarish.
en: Q: What does a DCS let an operator do? A: Monitor and control the whole plant from the control room via screens.

uz: Vibratsiya monitoringi turbina 'salomatligining' asosiy ko'rsatkichi. Podshipniklardagi datchiklar vibratsiyani doimiy o'lchaydi — o'sishi nosozlikdan darak beradi.
en: Vibration monitoring is a key indicator of turbine 'health'. Sensors on the bearings measure vibration continuously — a rise signals trouble.

uz: Vibratsiya keskin oshsa turbina avtomatik 'trip' bo'ladi — bu rotorning tegib ketishi yoki parchalanishidan katta zararning oldini oladi.
en: If vibration rises sharply the turbine automatically trips — preventing major damage from rotor rubbing or breaking apart.

uz: SAVOL: Vibratsiya keskin oshsa turbina nima qiladi? JAVOB: Avtomatik trip bo'ladi (xavfsiz to'xtaydi) — katta shikastning oldini olish uchun.
en: Q: What does a turbine do if vibration rises sharply? A: It automatically trips (safely stops) — to prevent major damage.

uz: Combined cycle FIKi ~60% dan yuqori — bu ma'noda u dunyodagi eng samarali issiqlik elektr stansiyasi turi. Sababi: bir yoqilg'idan ikki marta ish olinadi.
en: Combined cycle efficiency exceeds ~60% — making it the most efficient type of thermal power plant. The reason: work is extracted twice from one fuel.

uz: SAVOL: Nega combined cycle oddiy gaz turbinasidan ancha samarali? JAVOB: U gaz turbinasi chiqindi issiqligini ham bug' turbinasida ishlatadi — bir yoqilg'idan ikki marta ish.
en: Q: Why is combined cycle much more efficient than a simple gas turbine? A: It also uses the gas turbine's waste heat in a steam turbine — two rounds of work from one fuel.
